purpose: Teach: ナンバーワン/しかるに/彷徨/踏み入れ/かなう/変人/親分/両足

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、地区のカフェナンバーワンを目指そうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's aim to be the number one café in the neighborhood, okay?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Gentle but purposeful. Reaches toward a shared future. Soft eye contact, almost conspiratorial—we're in this together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のレビューはしかるに大切だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Customer reviews really matter, don't they? We need to pay attention.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Recognizing something important without drama. A small nod of understanding. Quiet conviction about what counts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、街を彷徨ってお店を見つけて下さったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I loved that—customers wandering the streets, actually finding us. That's how they discovered the place.
lines.style: Bright, present moment. Soft wonder in the voice. Not boasting, just genuinely pleased at the small miracle of being found. Pace slightly slower on the discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新規開拓に踏み入れる時期ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's time to step into new territory, Aoi. Time to grow.
lines.style: Gentle but clear direction. A nudge forward, not a push. The voice of someone who sees potential and is naming it quietly. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の願いがかなうメニューを増やそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's expand the menu—bring in dishes that answer what our customers actually want.
lines.style: Warm proposal, collaborative tone. Building something together. 'Expand' carries lift; ending soft but resolute. Generous vision, not bossy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、変人扱いされても独自路線で行こうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even if people think we're a little different, we stay our own course. That's the strength.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. A hand on the shoulder—you don't have to fit the mold. Conviction without harshness. Pace even, grounded in principle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人を親分のように慕われてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed how the customers really looked up to you—like you were their anchor, their leader.
lines.style: Observant, tender. Noticing something Aoi may not see in herself. Soft, unhurried. The voice of someone who watches carefully and speaks only what's true.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、両足の靴を新しくしてサービスに臨もうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: So let's renew everything—step into service with fresh footing, fresh energy.
lines.style: Resolute but warm closing. 'Renew' carries both action and care. Pace builds slightly toward the end. A benediction and a beginning at once.
